method: Three independent raters route each phrase to exactly one action, blind to each other. Disagreement between raters is the collision signal. Inter-rater disagreement is used rather than self-reported confidence because introspective confidence is not calibrated and cannot be audited.
gaming_note: This set was written and committed BEFORE any routing was run, because Trellis §5.2 identifies 'curate the phrase set until it passes' as the way a distinctness budget gets gamed. If phrases are added later, they go in a separate file with its own date.
phrasing_rule: No phrase contains an action name. A phrase that names its action measures nothing.
